notes.notes:
1    Adjusted the way to destroy the crystal.
2.   Only one crystal remains in each area.

notes.title: Update Ver 0.8.6
notes.notes:
1. Added some background music.
2. Changed a few shortcuts：Right mouse button for special weapons；Use the F key to open the HUD and place the relay station
   
3. Crystal blood is further reduced. At the same time, attack crystal will accelerate the progress of crystal energy storage.

notes.title: Patch #3
notes.notes:
1. Fixed a possible issue which made you unable to shoot.
 2. Canceled the side shield unit.
 3. Added a firepower enhancement unit.
 4. Added an external ammunition box adapter socket.
 5. Added a quantum shield generator.
 6. Fixed a problem where when you reach a certain amount, the game slows down.

notes.title: Patch #1
notes.notes:
The following bugs have been fixed:
1. You continue to hear the walking sound when you have stopped.
2. You are unable to exit fullscreen.
3. Landmine mission can't be completed due to an issue.
4. Ores not always falling.
5. Robot won't repair.
6. Relay station connection not established because problem task has not been carried out.
7. Add a button on the start new game list.
------
We are currently working on improving the games English language and will be completed in the next patch.
Thank you for your support
